candidate.en: Feast of the village's patron saint

desc.hr: The feast of the village's patron saint is celebrated at the Sveti Martin church in Kampus.
Autumn grape harvest and winemaking is a village tradition still practised in Žrnovo.
Kumpanija je tradicionalni mješani oružani ples, koji se izvodi ljeti u pet naselja na Korčuli, uključujući i Pupnat. Pupnat je jedan od pet naselja na Korčuli koje očuvaju ovaj tradicionalni ples.
Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance.

Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.
